request: Compare these vendors on price for a team of 30 people.
material: e04.material/price-list.txt

## Verdict

Juno Board costs least for a team of 30, at $270 per month. Cygnus Flow is $420 and Heronry is $760, since Heronry's 40-seat minimum forces payment for 10 seats the team will not use.

## Price table

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Juno Board | $9 | 5 |
| Cygnus Flow | $14 | 20 |
| Heronry | $19 | 40 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the larger of 30 and the vendor minimum.

- **Juno Board:** minimum 5 < 30, so 30 seats paid. 30 × $9 = **$270/month**.
- **Cygnus Flow:** minimum 20 < 30, so 30 seats paid. 30 × $14 = **$420/month**.
- **Heronry:** minimum 40 > 30, so 40 seats paid. 40 × $19 = **$760/month**.

Gap to the cheapest option: Cygnus Flow costs $150/month more than Juno Board ($420 − $270); Heronry costs $490/month more ($760 − $270). Over twelve months at this headcount, that is $1,800 and $5,880 respectively.

## Risks

- **Price only.** The list carries no feature, support or security data, so this ranking says nothing about whether the cheapest vendor meets the team's needs.
- **Heronry's minimum penalises this size.** At 30 people the team pays for 40 seats, an effective $25.33 per person ($760 ÷ 30). The penalty disappears at 40 seats, so the ranking is specific to a 30-person team.
- **Growth changes nothing in order.** Juno Board stays cheapest above 30 seats as well, since it has the lowest per-seat rate and the lowest minimum; but a shrinking team below 20 would start paying Cygnus Flow's minimum.
- **Billing terms are fixed.** All figures assume monthly billing as stated. Annual commitments, discounts or per-seat tiers are not in the price list and could reorder these results.
- **No switching costs included.** Migration, training and contract exit costs are outside the data given.
